def arm_seed_bits(arm, block_index, master):
    length = tl.seed_bits_for(N)
    prefix = f"{tl.SEED_PREFIX}:{int(master)}:{arm}:{int(block_index)}"
    buf = bytearray()
    counter = 0
    while len(buf) * 8 < length:
        buf.extend(hashlib.sha256(f"{prefix}:{counter}".encode("ascii")).digest())
        counter += 1
    bits = np.unpackbits(np.frombuffer(bytes(buf), dtype=np.uint8), bitorder="big")
    return bits[:length].astype(np.uint8)


def direct_marginal_table(table):
    joint = table.reshape(Q, Q, table.shape[1])
    colsum = table.sum(axis=0)
    return (joint.sum(axis=0) / colsum[None, :]).T


def decode_layer(logp, positions, disclosed, field):
    result = sc_decode(logp, field=field, alpha=ALPHA, known_positions=positions, known_values=disclosed)
    if bool(np.isnan(result.decision_metrics).any()) or bool(np.isposinf(result.decision_metrics).any()):
        raise RuntimeError("numeric nonfinite failure: invalid decision marginals")
    return result


def cell4(first_exact, second_exact, first_key, second_key):
    if first_exact and second_exact:
        return "both_exact"
    if first_exact:
        return first_key
    if second_exact:
        return second_key
    return "neither"


def body_from_command(command):
    lines = command.splitlines()
    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip().endswith("<<'X03B'"))
    stop = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].strip() == "X03B")
    return "\n".join(lines[start + 1:stop]) + "\n"


def stage_prereg():
    global prereg_sha, command_text, body_sha_match, body_sha
    text = PREREG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    prereg_sha = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    match = re.search(r"```bash\n(.*?)\n```", text, re.S)
    if match is None:
        raise RuntimeError("prereg bash command block not found")
    command_text = match.group(1)
    executed = BODY_LOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if BODY_LOG.exists() else ""
    body_sha = hashlib.sha256(executed.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    body_sha_match = body_sha == hashlib.sha256(
        body_from_command(command_text).encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()
    log(f"prereg_sha256={prereg_sha} body_sha256={body_sha} body_sha_match={body_sha_match}")
    if not body_sha_match:
        raise RuntimeError("staged body is not byte-identical to the prereg heredoc body")


def x03_body_sha_from_prereg():
    if not X03_PREREG.exists():
        return None
    text = X03_PREREG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    match = re.search(r"```bash\n(.*?)\n```", text, re.S)
    if match is None:
        return None
    lines = match.group(1).splitlines()
    start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.rstrip().endswith("<<'X03'"))
    stop = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].strip() == "X03")
    return hashlib.sha256(("\n".join(lines[start + 1:stop]) + "\n").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def aggregate(values):
    vals = [float(v) for v in values]
    return {
        "mean": statistics.mean(vals),
        "sample_std": statistics.stdev(vals) if len(vals) > 1 else 0.0,
        "range": [min(vals), max(vals)],
    }


def metric_stats(records):
    true_vals = [float(r["marg_vs_true_conditioned_maxdiff"]) for r in records]
    direct_vals = [float(r["marg_vs_direct_maxdiff"]) for r in records]
    direct_mean_vals = [float(r["marg_vs_direct_mean_abs"]) for r in records]
    hard_vals = [float(r["marg_vs_hard_maxdiff"]) for r in records if r["marg_vs_hard_maxdiff"] is not None]
    rows = len(true_vals)
    rows_gt = int(sum(1 for v in true_vals if v > 1e-12))
    return {
        "marginal_vs_true_conditioned_observed_block_rows": {
            "rows": int(rows),
            "max_abs_diff": float(max(true_vals)) if rows else None,
            "rows_gt_1e-12": rows_gt,
            "row_fraction_gt_1e-12": (float(rows_gt) / rows) if rows else None,
        },
        "marginal_vs_direct_joint_marginal_per_block_rows": {
            "rows": int(len(direct_vals)),
            "max_abs_diff": float(max(direct_vals)) if direct_vals else None,
            "max_mean_abs_diff": float(max(direct_mean_vals)) if direct_mean_vals else None,
        },
        "marginal_vs_hard_candidate_rows": {
            "rows_with_l1_candidate": int(len(hard_vals)),
            "max_abs_diff": float(max(hard_vals)) if hard_vals else None,
        },
    }

                        block_public[arm] += seed_bits

                            oracle_label_hat = label_hat
                    except Exception:
